description:
Asking prices in one district or city of Cyprus for one kind of home: per square metre and for the
whole home - the median, the mean and the middle half - with the number of homes they stand on, the
day, and the city's median beside a district's. `bedrooms` 0 to 4 for apartments, 2 to 5 for houses.
They are asking prices in adverts, each home counted once - not sale prices.

bedrooms.description: The number of bedrooms: 0 (a studio) to 4 for apartments, 2 to 5 for houses.
bedrooms.title: Bedrooms

lang.description: The language of the names and links in the answer: en (English), el (Greek), ru (Russian), uk (Ukrainian), he (Hebrew) or zh (Chinese).
lang.title: Lang
